    (readsec::numeric / wordlen::numeric) as sec_per_word,
    (readsec::numeric / wordlen::numeric) * CASE difflevel

        WHEN 'Basic' THEN 1.0
        WHEN 'Intermediate' THEN 1.5
        WHEN 'Advanced' THEN 2.0
    END as factor,
    (readsec::numeric / wordlen::numeric) * 100 * CASE difflevel 
        WHEN 'Basic' THEN 1.0
        WHEN 'Intermediate' THEN 1.5
        WHEN 'Advanced' THEN 2.0
    END as ars_adjusted
FROM articles LIMIT 5;
